references.title: Throughput Maximization of UAV Networks
references.supports: 20 MHz spectrum segment per UAV; OFDMA; 100 resource blocks of 180 kHz with 2 MHz outside occupied resource blocks.
references.does_not_support: Our 27dBm, 25-UE cap, 4Mbps demand, spectrum reuse, or exact physical throughput. Audit bandwidth is a simplified effective Shannon budget, not a full LTE resource grid.

references.title: Performance Evaluation of Direct-Link Backhaul for UAV-Aided Emergency Networks
references.supports: 20 MHz sub-6GHz backhaul; five 20MHz component carriers give 100MHz aggregate in a separate carrier-aggregation case.
references.does_not_support: Our 5GHz, 20dBm backhaul or continuous 100MHz single-radio implementation; that paper uses 3.5GHz and different power. 40MHz is an exploratory sensitivity point.

references.title: Analysis of Duplexing Patterns in Multi-Hop mmWave Integrated Access and Backhaul Systems
references.venue: IEEE Open Journal of the Communications Society 5, 5392-5407, 2024
references.supports: Half-duplex constraints, link scheduling and resource allocation must be considered jointly.
references.does_not_support: Our specific sub-6GHz propagation, topology, bandwidth or identical numerical results.

references.title: 3GPP TS 36.101 / ETSI TS 136 101 V8.10.0
references.supports: LTE channel bandwidth options include 5, 10, 15 and 20MHz.
references.does_not_support: A claim that 20MHz is uniquely required, locally allocated spectrum, or sufficient for our traffic.
